```python
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import MultiCut, CartesianCut

# Define jet multiplicity binning (exactly 4, exactly 5, at least 6 jets of JetGood)
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="jet_mult",
    cuts={
        "4j": "nJetGood == 4",
        "5j": "nJetGood == 5",
        "6pj": "nJetGood >= 6",
    }
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning (exactly 2, at least 3 b-jets)
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="btag_mult",
    cuts={
        "2b": "nBTag == 2",
        "3pb": "nBTag >= 3",
    }
)

# Create cartesian product of both binnings
categories = CartesianCut(
    jet_multiplicity,
    btag_multiplicity
)
```
